classification: post-hoc parameter robustness audit; not a new independent alpha test
purpose: Separate robust parameter plateaus from historically scanned or untested parameters using path bootstrap, existing grid re-evaluation, and Latin-hypercube overlay perturbation.
decision_rules: A parameter is qualified_plateau only when at least 75% of every reported adjacent cell passes the v2 point and bootstrap thresholds in each lineage where it appears.
A parameter with only a small historical scan is historical_scan_only, never qualified_plateau.
A parameter without an adjacent-grid or randomized-neighbour experiment is not_monte_carlo_tested.
No best cell is selected from this audit.
No leverage, order, paper target, or production change is permitted from this round.
known_limits: Block bootstrap resamples historical daily returns and cannot create unseen regimes.
Existing parameter-grid cells are correlated; treating them as independent trials would overstate evidence.
The full historical trial ledger is unavailable, so PBO and Deflated Sharpe are not claimed.
R360 industry classification is a current-snapshot backfill, not point-in-time data.
Historical HS300 membership and ETF adjusted-price limitations remain from R344/R359/R360.
